description_en: Creates a business travel enterprise for a channel partner's counterpart, automatically establishing the bindingrelationship between the channel application and the counterpart enterprise to enable data interoperability
description_zh: 渠道伙伴通过调用本接口可快速创建对接方的商旅企业，无需其他操作即可实现渠道应用与对接企业的绑定关系，实现数据互通互联
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen channel-corp-create --third-corp-id fliggy_001 --corp-name '阿里巴巴有限公司' --administrator-name '张三' --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChannelCorpCreate

parameters.help_en:
The custom business travel enterprise ID of the counterpart.
Character length limit: 5 ≤ length ≤ 20.
Use the counterpart name plus a number, such as fliggy_001
parameters.help_zh:
自定义对接方商旅企业 ID。
字符长度限制：5 ≤ 字符 ≤ 20。
建议使用对接方名称+数字形式，如：fliggy_001
parameters.name: third_corp_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom business travel enterprise name of the counterpart.
Character length limit: 5 ≤ length ≤ 20.
Use the actual enterprise name of the counterpart
parameters.help_zh:
自定义对接方商旅企业名称。
字符限制：5 ≤ 字符长度 ≤ 20。
建议使用对接方实际企业名称
parameters.name: corp_name

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the counterpart enterprise. This parameter is optional. If not specified, the system automatically generates one
parameters.help_zh: 对接企业用户 ID，按需传入，若不传，系统会自动生成
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the counterpart enterprise administrator
parameters.help_zh: 对接方企业管理员手机号
parameters.name: administrator_phone

parameters.help_en: The name of the counterpart enterprise administrator
parameters.help_zh: 对接方企业管理员姓名
parameters.name: administrator_name

parameters.help_en: The travel scale of the counterpart
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The province where the counterpart enterprise is located
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city where the counterpart enterprise is located
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

When calling this operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain it, see Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending this parameter, use `crop_token=value` instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，推荐使用 `crop_token=value` 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

parameters.help_en: A JSON string with key-value pairs where both key and value are strings
parameters.name: extend_field

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Business Travel region version. Select GLOBAL for enterprises that do not settle in RMB. Valid values:
● CN: Chinese mainland edition.
● GLOBAL: Global edition.
⚠️Default value: CN
parameters.help_zh:
阿里商旅区域版本，非人民币结算企业请选择GLOBAL。
枚举值：
● CN：中国大陆版
● GLOBAL：全球版
⚠️不传则默认"CN"
parameters.name: btrip_region

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise base currency (settlement currency). Required when btrip_region is GLOBAL. Not used when btrip_region is CN. Valid values:
● USD: US dollar.
● HKD: Hong Kong dollar
parameters.help_zh:
企业本位币（结算货币）。当btrip_region为GLOBAL时，该字段必填；当btrip_region为CN时，该字段弃用。
枚举值：
● USD：美元
● HKD：港币
parameters.name: base_currency

parameters.help_en: The custom English name of the counterpart business travel enterprise, used for the internationalized version display
parameters.help_zh: 自定义对接方商旅企业英文名称，国际化版本展示用
parameters.name: corp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The counterpart enterprise administrator email address.
⚠️Either the phone number or this field is required. When this field is specified, the enterprise defaults to email activation
parameters.help_zh:
对接方企业管理员邮箱。
⚠️和手机二选一必填该字段传入时，企业默认为“邮箱激活”
parameters.name: administrator_email

administrator_name.description_en: The name of the business travel enterprise administrator

administrator_phone.description_en: The phone number of the business travel enterprise administrator
administrator_phone.description_zh: 商旅企业管理员手机号

open_agent_id.description_en: The business travel enterprise agent ID

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

traceId.description_en: The trace ID used for global request tracking, typically for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
